rows.section: Tax credits 2026 (CIS, CI-CO2, CIP, CIM, CISSM)
rows.label: Employee tax credit (CIS): maximum per year
rows.note: Credits are paid through payroll (or the pension fund) and refunded where they exceed the tax. The CIS and CI-CO2 need at least €936 of salary a year.
rows.source_title: ACD: L.I.R., texte coordonné en vigueur au 1er janvier 2026 (date d'actualisation 08/05/2026), art. 154quater (CIS), 154quinquies (CIP) and 152ter (CII)

rows.section: Tax credits 2026 (CIS, CI-CO2, CIP, CIM, CISSM)
rows.label: CIS: amount by gross salary
rows.value: €300 + 2.9% of salary above €936 up to €11,265; €600 from €11,266 to €40,000; then reduced by 1.5% of salary above €40,000
rows.note: Credits are paid through payroll (or the pension fund) and refunded where they exceed the tax. The CIS and CI-CO2 need at least €936 of salary a year.
rows.source_title: ACD: L.I.R., texte coordonné en vigueur au 1er janvier 2026 (date d'actualisation 08/05/2026), art. 154quater (CIS), 154quinquies (CIP) and 152ter (CII)

rows.note: Credits are paid through payroll (or the pension fund) and refunded where they exceed the tax. The CIS and CI-CO2 need at least €936 of salary a year.

rows.note: Raised from €192 for 2026
rows.source_title: Journal officiel (Legilux), Mémorial A N° 591 du 19 décembre 2025: Loi du 19 décembre 2025 concernant le budget des recettes et des dépenses de l'État pour l'exercice 2026, art. 3

rows.section: Tax credits 2026 (CIS, CI-CO2, CIP, CIM, CISSM)
rows.label: CI-CO2: phase-out
rows.value: Reduced by 0.54% of gross income above €40,000; nil from €80,000
rows.note: Credits are paid through payroll (or the pension fund) and refunded where they exceed the tax. The CIS and CI-CO2 need at least €936 of salary a year.
rows.source_title: Journal officiel (Legilux), Mémorial A N° 591 du 19 décembre 2025: Loi du 19 décembre 2025 concernant le budget des recettes et des dépenses de l'État pour l'exercice 2026, art. 3

rows.section: Tax credits 2026 (CIS, CI-CO2, CIP, CIM, CISSM)
rows.label: Pensioner tax credit (CIP) and self-employed tax credit (CII)
rows.value: Same amounts as the CIS (maximum €600, nil from €80,000); the three credits cannot be combined
rows.note: Credits are paid through payroll (or the pension fund) and refunded where they exceed the tax. The CIS and CI-CO2 need at least €936 of salary a year.
